svg.text: Where the multispectral bands sit on the spectrum
Centers and widths vary between cameras. These are typical of a five-band survey camera.
the red edge: the steep climb
NDVI is the size of the gap between these two
near-infrared: invisible, and where the signal is
it stops here, and records nothing past red
Landsat also carries two shortwave-infrared bands at 1610 and 2200 nm, far off the right of this chart, that no drone camera has.
